msg.periodicPathAutoDisabled: Detected empty storage paths and automatically disabled related toggles: {items}

weekNumRule.title: Week number rule
weekNumRule.hint: Calendar week: the week containing Jan 1 is week 1. ISO 8601: the week starts on Monday and the week containing the first Thursday is week 1; it only takes effect when “Week starts on” is set to Monday. Weekly notes with document attributes are unaffected by switching rules; if historical weekly notes have no attributes yet, run “Backfill Now” before changing this setting.

backfillAttrs.title: Backfill periodic note attributes
backfillAttrs.hint: Periodic notes created after v0.5.0 already have document attributes automatically. Only notes created before v0.5.0 need backfilling. This scans the weekly/monthly/yearly notes in the current notebook and adds missing attributes, so the calendar can still find them even if you change their storage paths later.
backfillAttrs.nothingToBackfill: All periodic notes already have attributes. Nothing to backfill.
backfillAttrs.error: Failed to backfill attributes. Check console for details.
backfillAttrs.noNotebook: No notebook selected. Please select a notebook first.
backfillAttrs.notSupported: Backfill is not supported by the current notebook instance.

dayRolloverHour.title: New day starts at
dayRolloverHour.hint: Before this time, "today" is still treated as the previous day. For example, with 02:30, clicking Today before 2:30 AM opens/creates yesterday's daily note. Hour 0–23, minute 0–59.

confirmCreateDailyNote.title: Confirm before creating daily note
confirmCreateDailyNote.hint: When enabled, clicking a date without a daily note shows a confirmation dialog before creating it. Turn off to create immediately.

weekly.pathHint: You can use date template variables, e.g. /Daily Notes/{{now | date "2006/01"}}/{{now | date "2006"}}-W{{weekly}} — {{weekly}} is the week number.
weekly.templateHint: e.g. weekly-template.md — place this file under workspace/data/templates/. Leave empty to skip template rendering.

autoCreateWeekly.title: Automatically create weekly note
autoCreateWeekly.hint: When creating a daily note, create the current weekly note if it does not exist.
autoCreateWeekly.forcedHint: Forced on because the weekly note path contains the daily note path.

yearly.pathHint: You can use date template variables, e.g. /Daily Notes/Yearly/{{now | date "2006"}}.
